parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
Two molecules of compound **F** react together under suitable conditions to form compound **G**. Some information about compounds **F** and **G** is given.

- The mass spectrum of **F** has a peak due to the molecular ion at $m/e = 106$, and a peak at $m/e = 107$ with an abundance 8% of the 106 peak.
- The mass spectrum of **G** has a peak due to the molecular ion at $m/e = 212$, and major peaks at $m/e = 91$ and $m/e = 105$.
- Both **F** and **G** contain oxygen and are neutral compounds which are insoluble in water.
- The $^{1}\text{H NMR}$ spectrum of **F** includes a singlet peak at $\delta = 10.0$ due to one proton.
- The $^{1}\text{H NMR}$ spectrum of **G** includes a singlet peak at $\delta = 5.1$ due to two protons.
- When **G** is heated with dilute sulfuric acid, benzoic acid, $\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{5}\text{CO}_{2}\text{H}$, and phenylmethanol, $\text{C}_{6}\text{H}_{5}\text{CH}_{2}\text{OH}$, are produced.

Use this information to answer (i)-(vi).
parts.text: Explain how the mass spectrum of **F** shows that a molecule of **F** contains seven carbon atoms. Show your working.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest the molecular formula of the fragment of **G** at $m/e = 91$.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest the molecular formulae of **F** and **G**.

parts.label: (a)(v)
parts.text: On the structures you have drawn in (iv), circle the protons responsible for the $^{1}\text{H NMR}$ peaks at $\delta = 10.0$ in **F** and $\delta = 5.1$ in **G**.

parts.label: (a)(vi)
parts.text: State the type of reaction that **G** undergoes when heated with dilute sulfuric acid.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Describe and explain the relative acidities of benzoic acid, phenylmethanol and 4-methylphenol.
